```plato

//==
// # Query results

// The outcome of intersecting a line, ray, or segment with a Plane. Hit is the
// validity flag (CONVENTIONS.md - partial operations: a concrete result record
// with a validity field, never a generic Optional): when Hit is true, Point is
// the crossing point and Parameter its parameter along the queried primitive;
// when Hit is false (the primitive is parallel to the plane, including the
// coincident case, or crosses outside a ray's or segment's extent) Point and
// Parameter are the queried primitive's own origin and 0 and carry no meaning.
type PlaneHit3D
    implements IValue
{
    Hit: Boolean;
    Point: Point3D;
    Parameter: Number;
}
```
